profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ EF World Journeys

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Co-founded a company focused on creating software to aid individuals with speech disabilities
- Wrote several iOS and Android apps including HandySpeech, the only handwriting-to-speech app on the market; published and maintained on iOS and Android stores
- Led user research and testing with American School for the Deaf to identify unmet needs and prioritize functional requirements 
- Featured on NBC CT, Fox CT, Hartford Courant; Recognized by the Education Committee of CT General Assembly for contribution to people with disabilities

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led software efforts on an R&D project aimed at developing a predictive maintenance system for medical diagnostic robots such as large PCR automation machines and allergen testers; present project at a leading clinical chemistry conference
- Utilized C# to interface with custom C++ firmware for reading data from electronic sensors such as accelerometers, flow rate meters and magnetometers via I2C and SPI
- Developed cloud-based solutions relying on MQTT to ingest sensor data and visualize using real-time graphing
- Collaborated with the mechanical and electrical teams using an Agile/Scrum model to design, develop and build robotics test systems
- Designed and engineered complex user interfaces (UIs) for interacting with diagnostic assets, improving repair workflow for technicians
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Software Development · Software Architecture

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant - Korey Stringer Institute
positions.description:
- Conducted research on body cooling technologies such as Kelvi, and their effectiveness on reducing body temperatures during exercise
- Spearheaded human trials and conducted research in a simulated hot / humid environment 
- Collaborated with other researchers to process data and create meaningful results and scientific papers

positions.title: Security Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Automated collection, filtering and processing of endpoint security data from multiple sources (FireEye, SEP, CarbonBlack); visualized data using Tableau views to create meaningful insights into security posture, allowing for greater visibility of the corporate network
- Authored documentation on procedures for querying and updating the visualization tools with current information, utilizing REST APIs 
- Gained exposure to the role of information security in drug development and production at a leading biotech company

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant - Human Performance Laboratory
positions.description:
- Conducted research on ACL injuries and their effect on gait and rehabilitation
- Led data collection on patients with injuries using motion capture technology
- Collaborated with other researchers to analyze and process data for use in mathematical models
- Developed mobile and web apps using JavaScript/Ajax to assist with portable data collection in the field and in medical settings

positions.title: Information Security and Data Privacy Intern
positions.description:
- Developed automated software tools in Java to interface between Microsoft Teams and internal infrastructure leading to accelerated  workflows for analyst investigation, utilizing Azure Cloud to deploy, host and manage
- Leveraged CyberARK to manage infrastructure credentials, allowing for a more robust password rotation protocol and leading to increased data security across the company
- Experienced day to day functions of information security as it relates to drug development and pharmaceutical research at a large biotech company

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
- Updated key district technologies for the new school year
- Deployed software updates, troubleshooting, and device configuration for thousands of Google ChromeBooks, Apple iPads, Windows Desktops
- Repaired malfunctioning equipment and installed new hardware for use by teachers, students, and administrators
